rules.statement: The first defendant's rights to inheritance were abandoned through his conduct, including signing as an attesting witness to a deed transferring the entirety of the land and making a statement to the police that he was residing in the house with the consent of the plaintiff.
rules.supporting_quote:
The 1st defendant who is the father of Kadija Umma has acknowledged the latter's title to the entirety of the land when he signed as an attesting witness to the deed.
Learned Counsel for the appellant submitted that the 1st defendant signed as an attesting witness to the transfer of only Kadija Umma's share, which was the western 1/2 share of the land, while his rights lay in the eastern portion of the land. But the eastern portion had earlier been gifted to Kowa by Kadija Umma's grandparents.

The 1st defendant denied that he was living in the house with the leave and licence of the plaintiff but conceded that the statement to the Police was made voluntarily by him when the plaintiff sent him a notice to quit; and he is bound by it.
